relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: In vivo treatment with MCC950 significantly reduced caspase-1 activation-associated bioluminescent signals in vivo and decreased stimulus-evoked and non-stimulus evoked nociception.

relationships.subject: Caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: we have demonstrated, using in vivo imaging, that repetitive closed-head mTBIs produce a significant increase in caspase-1-mediated inflammation, which is coincident with the development of long-term pain behavior states

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that 10 mg/kg of MCC950 adequately attenuated mTBI-induced nociceptive sensitization.

key_findings: Repeated mild TBI increased caspase-1 activation in brain, paws and DRG and produced persistent allodynia and grimace scores.
NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950 reduced caspase-1 activation and nociceptive sensitization.
